# Fares Ayadi — Freelance Fullstack Developer & Automation Engineer

> Fullstack systems and automation, built to spec. I design, build, and ship web applications, APIs, and automation pipelines for small and medium businesses.

## About

Freelance fullstack software engineer specializing in custom website building, web app development, and business process automation. Available for hire on a project basis.

## Services

- **Fullstack web development** — Marketing sites, dashboards, and web apps built with React, Vue, or Svelte on the front end and Flask, Hono, or a custom API on the back. Responsive, fast, and easy for your team to update.
- **Business process automation** — Scripted workflows that remove manual, repetitive work — data entry, report generation, file processing, and system-to-system syncing — using Python.
- **APIs & backend systems** — Clean, documented REST APIs backed by MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or SQLite — sized to the business, not over-engineered for a scale you do not have yet.
- **Data tooling & light ML** — Reporting, dashboards, and forecasting built on NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Scikit-learn, and PyTorch — turning spreadsheets and logs into decisions.

## Tech Stack

- **Frontend:** React, Vue, Svelte, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript
- **Backend:** Python, Flask, Hono, Node.js, Express
- **Databases:** MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQLite, Turso
- **Cloud/Infra:** Cloudflare Workers, Vercel, Docker, Linux
- **Tools:** Git, GitHub Actions, REST APIs, WebSockets

## Notable Projects

- **Pet ID.tn** — Platform for pet identification using smart tags, built with Svelte, Hono, and SQLite on Cloudflare.
- **Fidelito.tn** — Digital loyalty card for small to medium businesses using a secure RFC 6238 QR code.
- **SMU FabLab** — Inventory management system with role-based access built with Nuxt.js.
- **Smart Crop Disease Reporter** — Android app using AI (YOLO, MobileNet, Gemini) for real-time plant disease detection.
